newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen says GDP grows real 11.06 pct Jan to Nov.
newsitem.headline: Yemen says GDP grows real 11.06 pct Jan to Nov.

text.p: Yemen's gross domestic product (GDP) rose a real 11.06 percent from January to end-November compared to 9.6 percent real growth in the same period last year, an official said on Wednesday.

The official at the state's Central Statistics Bureau said the growth was due to the economic reforms that Yemen launched in March 1995 in agreement with the World Bank and International Monetary Fund.

Yemen has raised prices of fuel, electricity, water and telephone rates as part of the reform programme. It has also received loans worth millions of dollars from several countries and international organisations under the plan.
